name: SOC 2 Type II
description: AICPA SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria for Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy.

requirements.title: Logical and Physical Access Controls
requirements.description: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events to meet the entity's objectives.

requirements.title: User Registration and Access Authorization
requirements.description: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity registers and authorizes new internal and external users whose access is administered by the entity.

requirements.title: Access Revocation and Modification
requirements.description: The entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access to data, software, functions, and other protected information assets based on changes in job responsibilities or termination of employment.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection and Network Defense
requirements.description: The entity implements logical boundaries and network protection mechanisms (e.g. firewalls, segmentation, IDS/IPS) to prevent unauthorized network access.

requirements.title: Transmission Data Protection and Encryption
requirements.description: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized internal and external users and protects data in transit using strong encryption.

requirements.title: Malicious Software Prevention
requirements.description: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.

requirements.title: Vulnerability and Configuration Management
requirements.description: To meet its objectives, the entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations that result in the introduction of new vulnerabilities, and performs recurring vulnerability scanning and patch management.

requirements.title: Security Incident Monitoring and Response
requirements.description: The entity monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies that are indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and technical failures, and implements incident response procedures.

requirements.title: Change Management and Authorization
requirements.description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet its objectives.
